thickness_model: nominal is course_thickness_mm for the course a point sits in. Every thinning defect subtracts loss_mm * cos(pi/2 * d / patch_radius_m) for a point d metres from its centre, and nothing beyond that radius.
evaluation_scene: The hidden wall loss on this run is heavier than a real shell of this age would carry. It is set that way so a probe planner can be measured against another one: with a single hidden patch the run held four rejectable points and no comparison on four points can separate anything.
